self_training_classifier.summary: A base learner fitted on the labelled bars labels the unlabelled bars it is most sure of, is refitted on them, and repeats: scikit-learn's self-training loop, one reported round at a time.
self_training_classifier.implementationNote: Bridge: the SelfTrainingClassifier loop written out (fit on labelled rows, admit pool rows whose top class probability is above the threshold, refit), one solver pass per round; P(up) from the final learner; the price uses a 3-regressor bootstrap committee admitting rows it agrees on most. Differs from the spec: labels masked in embargoed blocks for an unlabelled pool, a deliberate handicap. Expect: close to its base learner.

labeled_fraction.label: Labeled fraction
labeled_fraction.description: Share of the training span's blocks whose labels are kept; the other blocks (and an embargo of the label horizon around them) form the unlabelled pool.

masking_block_bars.label: Masking block bars
masking_block_bars.description: Length in bars of the contiguous blocks labels are kept or hidden in.

base_learner.label: Base learner
base_learner.description: The model retrained every round: logistic regression (ridge for the price), histogram gradient boosting (100 rounds of 15-leaf trees) or a random forest (40 trees of depth 8).

regularization_strength.label: Regularization strength
regularization_strength.description: Inverse L2 penalty of the logistic base learner (C; 1/alpha of the ridge); the tree learners ignore it.

maximum_rounds.label: Maximum rounds
maximum_rounds.description: Pseudo-labelling rounds before stopping (each is one solver pass).

confidence_threshold.label: Confidence threshold
confidence_threshold.description: A pool row is admitted when its most likely class has a probability above this.

pseudo_target_share.label: Pseudo-target share
pseudo_target_share.description: Price model only: share of the pool admitted per round, the rows the regressors agree on most.

tri_training.summary: Three learners fitted on bootstrap samples of the labelled bars teach each other: a learner receives the unlabelled bars on which the other two agree, under Zhou and Li's error-rate conditions, until none changes.
tri_training.implementationNote: Bridge: Zhou-Li tri-training: three learners on bootstrap samples, each fed the pool rows the other two agree on under the paper's error-rate and size conditions, until none changes; P(up) is the mean of the three; the price is tri-regression on rows the other two agree on most. Differs from the spec: i.i.d. bootstrap, not time-aware; labels masked in embargoed blocks, a deliberate handicap. Expect: a small bagging-like gain at best.

co_training.summary: Two learners, each reading one view of the feature columns, label their most confident unlabelled bars for each other round by round (Blum and Mitchell); P(up) combines the two views.
co_training.implementationNote: Bridge: Blum-Mitchell co-training on two views of the feature columns (grouped by what they measure: price, volume and order flow, volatility, news); each round each view labels its most confident up and down pool rows for both; P(up) combines the views as independent evidence. Differs from the spec: views are feature groups of one instrument, not independent; labels masked in embargoed blocks. Expect: at most the stronger view's edge.

multi_view_learning.summary: Two to four learners, one per view of the feature columns, are refitted each round on the labelled bars plus every unlabelled bar soft-labelled by the other views' consensus (co-EM); P(up) is their mean.
multi_view_learning.implementationNote: Bridge: co-EM: 2 to 4 views of the feature columns, each view's learner refitted every round on labelled rows plus all pool rows soft-labelled by the other views' consensus; P(up) is the mean of the views. Differs from the spec: no canonical correlation or deep multi-view variants; views are feature groups of one instrument; labels masked in embargoed blocks. Expect: close to the average of per-view learners.

transductive_support_vector_machine.summary: Joachims' transductive SVM: the unlabelled bars get balance-constrained labels from a labelled SVM, then their penalty is annealed upward while pairs of wrongly placed labels are swapped, pushing the margin through low-density regions.
transductive_support_vector_machine.implementationNote: Bridge: Joachims' transductive SVM: labelled SVM, balance-constrained labels for the pool, unlabelled penalty annealed upward while slack pairs are swapped; P(up) is a logistic curve of the decision value fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: rows capped and pairs swapped in batches per refit (no warm start); labels masked in embargoed blocks; no price model. Expect: near a linear SVM.
